data.name: Confounding Blades*
data.description: When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee weapon that deals sneak attack damage, her target cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1d4+1 rounds. The rogue must have the slow reactions rogue talent before she can choose this talent.
